book.name: Aklisiyestis
book.title: Aklisiyestis Det Wed Blanga Wanbala Klebawan Titja

content: Wal hau det klebabala jidan? Hu gin sabi ebrijing? Wen yu luk langa klebabala feis, im difrin. Det klebabalawei tjeinjim im en meigim im luk gudwei.
Dum wanim det king dalim yu
Wal yu garra duwit langa det boswan king, dumaji God bin meigim pramis langa im.
Nomo joinin kwikbala garram najalot blanga gibit bekboun langa det boswan king, im gin dum enijing im wandim.
En det boswan king wed im brabli strongbala. Nobodi kaan tok langa im, “Wotfo yu dum lagijat?” Najing!
Yu garra oldei duwit langa det king en nomo joinin garram najalot hu wandi gibit bekboun langa im. Yu jidan klebabala if yu duwit lagijat langa im, en yu sabi det rait taim blanga dum enijing.
Wal langa det rait taim pipul garra dum ebrijing, bat pipul oldei abumbat loda trabul en adtaim.
Dumaji nobodi kaan sabi wanim garra hepin bambai, en nobodi iya blanga dalim wi.
Wal nobodi kaan seibum miselp brom daidaibat. Nobodi kaan tok wotaim im garra dai. Nobodi kaan libum det ami wen det enamimob faitfaitbat langa olabat, en det nogudbalawei kaan seibum enibodi.

Wal aibin luk ol dislot ting en aibin jinggabat adbalawei blanga ebrijing weya bin hepin langa dijan wel. Wal langa dijan wel sambala pipul jidan garram loda pawa en dei gibitbat adtaim langa najalot pipul.
Det nogudbalawan en det gudbalawan

Trubala aibin luk dijan du. Aibin luk wen detlot nogudbala pipul bin dai, deibin abumbat bigiswan fyunral, en ola pipul langa det taun bin tok gudbalawei blanga detlot dedbala pipul, nomeda deibin dum blendibala nogudbala ting langa ola pipul langa det taun. Ai nomo sabi wotfo im lagijat.
Dumaji pipul nomo abum det panishmen streidawei blanga olabat nogudbalawei, wal pipul reken im rait en dei kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting olataim.

Wal nogudbala men mait dum loda nogudbala ting langa im laif en stil jidan laibala longtaim. Bat ai sabi im trubala, “If yu rispek en duwit wanim God wandim, wal ebrijing garra jidan gudwei blanga yu bambai.
Bat im nomo gudwan blanga ola nogudbala pipul, dumaji olabat laif im jis laiga shedo, en dei gin dai wen dei stil yangbala, dumaji dei nomo oldei duwit langa God.”

Bat ai nomo sabi dijan najawan ting. Wal samtaim det gudbala men weya im bulurrum God brabliwei, im oldei abum det panishmen blanga detlot nogudbala pipul, en detlot nogudbala pipul gajim ola gudwan ting. Ai nomo sabi wotfo im lagijat.

Wal trubala ai wandim ebribodi garra abum gudtaim langa dijan wel. Mobeda olabat kipgon dagadagatbat en dringgimbat en kipgon dumbat adwek, dumaji tharran na meigim wi jidan gudbinjiwei, en ai sabi God im gibit wi dijan.
Pipul nomo sabi ebrijing blanga Godwei
Wal wen aibin trai meigim miselp klebabala, wulijim ai gin sabi hau ebrijing hepin langa dijan wel, en aibin faindat ai kaan abum eni silip.
Afta na aibin jinggabat brabli wanim God im dumbat. Nomeda wi trai adbalawei bat wi nomo sabi, en nomeda wi jidan klebabala en sabi loda ting, bat wi stil nomo sabi wanim God dumbat.
